sql: SELECT round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28') / 7, 4) AS value, round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28')) / 28, 4) AS baseline FROM orders.orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-04-30' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-06-04'
